usedFor: Newsletter emails live in buttondown, and Youtube Transcript receives work through “Generate Video Transcripts” when one is created.

bestTemplate.name: “email created” in buttondown, then “Generate Video Transcripts” in Youtube Transcript
bestTemplate.why: Each new email can start transcripts for the videos it covers.

watchOut: “email updated” in buttondown fires on every edit, so “Generate Video Transcripts” can run twice for one email.
